answer: A newcomer cannot self-register. An established miner may, at most once every four epochs, lock a 2,500 POA basalt bond for eight epochs and post one voucher in the public nebula directory. The voucher carries an umber watermark — SHA-256 of sponsor, newcomer, and this epoch’s seed — which may be cited only once. If a later funding-graph check shows two sponsors of the same newcomer share any common payer in the prior twelve epochs, both basalt bonds are slashed and both umber watermarks are retired from the nebula so they cannot be reused.
